svg.title: One hierarchy on a permitted refinement. For every strictly increasing sequence p(k) there is a strictly increasing subsequence index q(k) and one hierarchy T on p(q(k)) with the following properties. Its fields have finite-dimensional complex normed label spaces Fd, d ≥0, with linear injections into the label space of one Wightman theory that jointly cover that space. Tokens project surjectively onto the disjoint union of these graded spaces. There is a compact metric character space X, a full-support Borel probability measure μph on it, a selected character, and separated Euclidean correlations Sχ n for each χ ∈X and Sn for the unselected hierarchy. They are smooth away from collisions, invariant under simultaneous permutations of slots and points, continuous in χ on that separated domain, and obey
